subject: prd/e2e-verification
statement: When e2e-design is invoked on a feature whose implementation tasks have all landed, the skill shall produce an e2e design doc containing scenarios, setup and teardown, a mock strategy, a harness design, a coverage map, and a per-scenario route.
rationale: the design doc is the reviewed artifact everything downstream consumes, and it must carry the machine that proves the coverage as well as the coverage itself
fit_criterion: on the dogfood feature and the fixture features, the produced doc contains all six parts, each non-empty or an explicit `none — <reason>`; the harness part satisfies FR-19 or FR-20 rather than naming a library only
